title: Buccaneers' undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels impresses in preseason debut

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Buccaneers' undrafted rookie QB Jalon Daniels impresses in preseason debut
sources.description: Buccaneers undrafted rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels is fourth on the depth chart, but he looked in his preseason debut like he might have an NFL future.
